mainEntity.name: How does Frasheski Construction ensure fixture compatibility with my home's existing systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction ensures fixture compatibility by reviewing all chosen fixtures against your home's existing plumbing, electrical, and structural systems during the design and pre-construction phases. This involves checking voltage requirements, pipe sizing, and necessary structural support. For example, in older homes common in areas like Berkeley or Oakland, we assess if existing wiring or plumbing needs upgrades to support new, modern fixtures, providing recommendations to meet current standards and ensure safe operation.
acceptedAnswer.description: We ensure compatibility by reviewing fixtures against your home's existing systems, checking requirements and recommending necessary upgrades, especially in older homes.
